module Leap
  ( isLeapYear
  ) where

import Prelude

-- | A year is a leap year if it divides by 4, except for centuries that
-- don't divide by 400.
isLeapYear :: Int -> Boolean
isLeapYear year = divisibleBy 4 && (not (divisibleBy 100) || divisibleBy 400)
  where
    divisibleBy n = year `mod` n == 0
